podcast.title: Inspiration for Band-Aid (November 11, 1984)
podcast.body: On the evening of November 11, 1984, after a difficult day attempting to publicize The Boomtown Rats' album "In the Long Grass," Bob Geldof watched a BBC documentary by reporter Michael Buerk detailing the famine in Ethiopia. Deeply affected by the images of starvation, Geldof felt compelled to take action, leading to the inception of the Band-Aid project. "Bob was stunned by the images of starving people, and he was suddenly moved to do something, anything to help these poor people."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Bob Geldof's Early Career
podcast.body: In the late 1970s, Bob Geldof was known as the frontman of The Boomtown Rats, prior to becoming famous as the instigator of the 1980s charity mega-projects Band Aid and Live Aid. "But in the late 70s, Guldoff was known as the frontman of the Boomtown Rats."

podcast.title: Bob Geldof's Self-Perception and Motivation
podcast.body: As described in his autobiography, Bob Geldof felt his limited influence as a "not very successful pop singer" making records "that no one bought" underscored his initial dilemma in responding to the Ethiopian famine. This self-assessment, however, fueled his determination to find a way to make a difference, ultimately leading to the creation of Band-Aid. "As he wrote in his autobiography, I was only a pop singer, and by now not a very successful pop singer, all I could do was make records that no one bought."

podcast.title: End of Collaboration with Mut Lang
podcast.body: Mut Lang ceased working with The Boomtown Rats after their third LP, fortunately switching his focus to ACDC, which led to global success far beyond what the Rats achieved. "He ceased working with the band after their third LP."

xref.title: Father of Peaches, Fifi, and Pixie Geldof
xref.body: Sir Bob Geldof, of The Boomtown Rats and Live Aid fame, is the father of daughters Peaches Honey Blossom Michelle Charlotte Angel Vanessa, Fifi Trixibelle, and Pixie. "And if you want to read some really vicious stuff about the offspring of Sir Bob Geldoff, he of the Boomtown rats in Live Aid, look up stuff on his daughter, Peaches Honey Blossom, Michelle Charlotte Angel Vanessa."
